title: Replace HubSpot With a Custom CRM Built in an Afternoon (Save $1,200/Year)
summary: HubSpot's Starter plan costs $1,200/year. Build a custom CRM with AI that does exactly what your sales team needs — contacts, pipeline, email tracking, and reporting included.
body_markdown: Gmail and Slack integrations are buildable with a single prompt each in Blink. Zapier or Make connects your custom CRM to any service with an API. The honest limit: for teams that rely on HubSpot's 1,500 native connector library — especially LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Salesforce two-way sync, or advanced marketing attribution — those integrations are a genuine advantage that a custom build does not replicate in an afternoon. That is a real reason to stay on HubSpot.
